description: This file contains extension methods for configuring dependency injection services in an ASP.NET Core application. Specifically, it sets up features like MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, JWT authentication, and Serilog logging.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to register application services, JWT authentication, and logging.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Configures and registers application services such as MediatR, validators, AutoMapper, password hashing, JWT token generator, and user context accessor.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Sets up JWT bearer authentication with specified signing key, issuer, audience, and token validation parameters.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Configures Serilog logging with console sink and attaches it to the ASP.NET Core logging pipeline.
